app_mcp.description: An app's own MCP endpoint, for its app users.

require_two_factor.description: An owner may require two-factor sign-in for every developer of the org.

app_oidc.description: An app may let its users sign in through an OpenID Connect identity provider.

hosted_logo.description: An app's hosted pages show its logo and accent colour, not only its name.

audit_export.description: The audit log can be exported as CSV.

addons.description: Add-ons can be bought on top of the plan.
